notes.title: Yeon x SlimeNot x LoveTech – A New Era Begins!
notes.notes:
[h2]Exciting News for the Future of Our Games![/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce a collaboration between Yeon, SlimeNot, and LoveTech! 🚀 This partnership will bring new projects, exciting updates, and unforgettable stories to life. Stay tuned for what’s coming next!

Want to explore our worlds? Check them out here:

🔗 [url=https://yeon-amber.vercel.app]Yeon Studio[/url]
🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SlimeNot]SlimeNot on Steam[/url]

What kind of game are you hoping to see next? Let us know in the comments! 👇🔥

notes.title: 🔧 Bug Fix – Choice Menus
notes.notes:
A bug was identified that broke the game in some choice menus.
The error occurred when, under certain conditions, dialogues appeared along with menus.

It has been fixed.
Thank you for your patience, all feedback is appreciated.

SlimeNot.

notes.title: Small Update - Achievements
notes.notes: We would like to thank the user NovaScotiaSean for informing us about an important detail related to achievements. Thanks to his notification, we were able to identify and fix the issue. The update has been applied, and everything is now working correctly. We greatly appreciate his collaboration!

notes.title: Small Update |
notes.notes: We've made a small update to Vida! Some text elements now have colors to better highlight marked or enabled options, preventing confusion. We've also made small fixes to the credits and other general improvements.

notes.title: Vida - Now Available on Steam
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355036/c2d29af69f1f198c990846d446fb344e95d5db2d.png[/img]

Vida is now available on Steam. Explore a narrative-driven journey that delves into memories and humanity in a fragmented world. Your choices shape the story in subtle ways. Play now and uncover what the past has left behind.

notes.title: Each story is a journey to understand what it means to be human
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355036/1ff4e958011708a3146b3d6e1e80617a1bcd495d.png[/img]
"Between memories and choices, we discover what makes us unique."

In "Vida", each story unveils a piece of the emotions that define us. Sometimes, a small choice can illuminate unexpected truths or bring long-forgotten feelings to the surface.

It’s not just about decisions, but the paths we take to understand our own memories and the connections that bind us together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355036/1ab019abb2118e9dba3f29e5af7d377fcb3d11f1.png[/img]

"It fit within a single memory, a multiverse."

notes.title: Ahoo, phew, the year is over.
notes.notes:
Hey there, folks! How’s it going? SlimeNot here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355036/ec37f5f18614c6c6561f01b0647495fb944dd91c.png[/img]

Happy belated New Year! How was your holiday season?
I managed to take some time off, enjoyed the beach and the pool, and relaxed a bit. But now I’m back to working on Vida.

Just stopping by to say I hope 2025 is full of joy for all of you!

notes.title: Hi, this is about the game.
notes.notes:
I sincerely hope you're all doing well. Some of you have been following me for a long time, while others are just arriving now. I just wanted to take a moment to welcome everyone again!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355036/07479d64e4441ab225a8eda7bab19ceb0e0f1d96.png[/img]  

This new game is set to launch in early 2025. I've been working on Visual Novels for a while, but I haven't shared anything here until now.  

I truly hope you'll enjoy it.  
Oh, did you notice we now have a [b]Curator Page[/b]?  
Check it out!  

Sending a big hug to your soul.
